rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The AICC press release of 29 April 2017 says 'The Congress President Smt. Sonia Gandhi has approved the composition of the Central Organisational Election Authority of the AICC', with Shri Mullapally Ramachandran as Chairman and Shri Bhubaneshwar Kalita and Shri Madhusudan Mistry as Members.
